description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers an opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development within a supportive environment.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in both educating our clinical team and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention. You will develop and implement staff training programs while also overseeing infection control policies and procedures to maintain a safe and healthy environment for residents and staff. This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42.

If you are a passionate Registered Nurse with a commitment to quality education and infection control, we encourage you to apply and become a key part of our compassionate care team.
requirements: Proven experience in staff development and education.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices.
Familiarity with regulatory requirements for skilled nursing facilities.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a facility that has recently undergone a change in ownership, presenting significant growth potential. We are looking for a highly presentable and results-driven individual who is eager to make a substantial impact on our community presence and census.

The ideal candidate will be a proactive leader, responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance the facility's reputation and drive admissions. This role requires a "hustler" mentality, someone who is not afraid to actively engage with the community, build strong referral networks, and consistently seek new opportunities for growth. Occasional weekend work will be required to support community events and outreach initiatives.

If you are a motivated marketing professional with a proven track record in the healthcare sector, particularly within skilled nursing or rehabilitation, and are looking for a role where your contributions are highly valued, we encourage you to apply. This position offers competitive compensation for the right individual who can demonstrate exceptional performance and dedication.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare environment.
Demonstrated professionalism and strong interpersonal skills, with a presentable demeanor.
Ability to work occasional weekends to support marketing and community outreach events.
A proactive and results-oriented approach to market development and census growth.
Strong understanding of the local healthcare market in Sarasota County, FL.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description: We are urgently seeking a dedicated and compassionate PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers an excellent opportunity to provide vital speech and language therapy services to patients, helping them regain communication and swallowing abilities.As a PRN SLP, you will enjoy the flexibility of a per diem schedule while making a significant impact on patient recovery and quality of life. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus to welcome you to our team.If you are a skilled SLP looking for a rewarding PRN opportunity in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive work culture.
requirements: Current and valid Florida state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC) from the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA)
Prior experience working as an SLP, preferably in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Ability to commit to PRN scheduling needs
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38.00 - $49.00 per hour, plus a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.

description: We are urgently seeking dedicated Full-time Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This critical role offers an immediate opportunity to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive and dynamic environment.As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, assisting patients in regaining mobility, strength, and function. You will implement individualized treatment plans, monitor patient progress, and provide compassionate care to help residents achieve their rehabilitation goals.This is a full-time position offering a competitive hourly rate and the chance to contribute to a team committed to excellence in patient care. If you are a motivated PTA looking for a rewarding career opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work effectively in a team environment
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.
